name: Familiar
description: A `Wizard` may discard their Familiar to ignore the effects of a single roll on the magical calamity table. Declare this after making the calamity roll but before resolving its effects.

name: Heavy Armour
description: Increase the Defense characteristic of the bearer by 2. The bearer can never move further than 4” in a single action.

name: Light Armour
description: Increase the Defense characteristic of the bearer by 1.

name: Shield
description: Increase the Defense characteristic of the bearer by 1.
